title: Indexed monomial
statement: Let $\iota$ be an index type, let $S$ be a finite subset of $\iota$, and let $x$ assign a sign to each element of $\iota$. The indexed monomial at $x$ is the product, over $i\in S$, of the real value of the sign assigned to $i$.
